'''Disinfectant pads''' were integral parts of a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> They were used to clean wounds and prevention infections, and were used in conjunction with [[antiseptic irrigation bulb]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
